item.title: Hire bike obstructing personalised disabled parking bay 00421, 14th August
item.description:
A dockless hire bike has been left within personalised disabled permit bay 00421 on Sigdon Road, obstructing the space reserved for the disabled permit holder. This is a newly installed personalised bay and is required for essential access by a resident with significant mobility difficulties. Please arrange for the bike to be removed as soon as possible and ensure this location is treated as a no-parking/no-obstruction area for dockless hire bikes. Photographs taken on 14 August 2026 are attached.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 53-57, Sigdon Road, Shacklewell, Greater London
